name: The nobility of the right hand
source:
You are Suaravi, the woman of the right hand of Pandemonium many, many, years ago.

Unlike some souls, Suaravi has not succumbed to the dark influence of Neverplace, she has embraced her power for the good of the souls who end up there. Now, she must find the child...the one who is destined to become the right eye of Pandemonium.

This is her story.

[From [url=https://seraten04.itch.io/the-nobility-of-the-right-hand]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是Suaravi，很多很多年前的魔界右手的女人。

与某些灵魂不同，Suaravi并没有屈服于Neverplace的黑暗影响，她为了最终到达那里的灵魂的利益而拥抱了自己的力量。现在，她必须找到那个孩子……那个注定成为魔界右眼的孩子。

这是她的故事。

[来自[url=https://seraten04.itch.io/the-nobility-of-the-right-hand]itch.io[/url]]
